config.design: Locked16 reused validation docs x2 lengths; adaptive write PCA and both Fisher ridges, budgets8/64. Add alpha times frozen reconstruction error to native L5H5 final head. Estimate directional logit derivative by central differences at .01 and .02; local Fisher is exact vocabulary-probability variance of that numerical derivative. Compare actual KL against local and H764 global quadratic predictions. No fitted parameters or outcome selection.
config.limitations: Numerical directional derivative, not analytic JVP. Reused validation documents. Local approximation diagnosed only along six reconstruction errors per context. Global metric has Monte Carlo and context sampling uncertainty.
